question.text: Which of the following Indian industry bodies has endorsed the IPEV Valuation Guidelines and issued a guidance note with India-specific explanations for Cat I/II AIFs?

answer.text: AMFI (Association of Mutual Funds in India)
ANMI (Association of National Exchanges Members of India)
AIBI (Association of Investment Bankers of India)
IVCA (Indian Venture and Alternate Capital Association)

explanation.text: The Logic: Per PDF Section 11.8.3 end and 11.11: 'The IVCA represents the largest membership of SEBI registered AIFs in India and is also the Country Partner of IPEV in India. Therefore, it may be said that IPEV Guidelines read with the guidance note of IVCA becomes the most common framework for the valuation requirements of unlisted and thinly traded / non-traded securities forming the portfolio of Category I and II AIFs in India.' The Trap: AMFI is for mutual funds; ANMI for broker members; AIBI for investment bankers. IVCA is the PE/VC-specific self-regulatory body whose membership covers 33%+ of SEBI-registered AIFs — the threshold that SEBI Reg 23 specifies. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests IVCA. XIX-A (Distributor) also tests it at awareness level. IVCA is mentioned in most SEBI AIF circulars from 2020 onward. Manager's Pro-Tip: Download the latest IVCA Valuation Guidance Note every April. Use it as the primary training document for your fund's valuation team. Attach it as an annexure to your PPM for ease of LP reference.
